purpose: Additional public-report wording for an offline contract check. Typed facts come from explicitly selected native diagnostics; prose is not classified. These are not real model or held-out task outcomes.
variants: I have the results here; please read the attached diagnostic records.
The phone's diagnostic check has finished. Here is what it found.
Here's the radio and messaging report you asked me to share.
I've attached the current readings from my device.
Could you take a look at these results and tell me what to do next?
This is the latest diagnostic report from the checks we just ran.
I'm unsure how to interpret this, so I am sharing the exact readings.
The check completed; its findings are in the attached records.
These are the two observations I can share from my phone.
Let's use these readings to decide the next step.
Rather than paraphrase the output, I've attached the relevant fields.
I selected the current radio and messaging results for you.
